snippet.title: what the HECK is Prego Wars?
snippet.description:
I'm finally going to try and make an indie game... This is the first video in a monthly series where I push to make my extremely ambitious dream game in just 6-12 months. The madness is only just beginning, LOL.

Wishlist the game!: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3085060/Prego_Wars/
Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/ZY7DX958pe

I post granular progress updates and am super active in the Discord, so if you're interested, pop in and see what's up!

#indiegame #indiedev #fps #gamedev
